meta.title: 原来S级主播是这样圈人群的
meta.title_en: This Is How S-Tier Streamers Target Their Audience

scenes.title_en: The Concept: A Niche, High-Bar Track
scenes.context: 以一个面具产品为例：在景区没什么流量，但在直播间就有流量，卖了两万单。这就是小众高门槛的赛道。要给主播一个卖点：因为好看、因为它帅、有收藏价值。语域：直播教学，案例引入。
sentences: 这个面具在景区没什么流量，但在你家就有流量。
This mask gets no traffic at scenic spots, but it sells out in your stream.
scenic spots（景区）；no traffic（没流量）
小众高门槛的赛道，卖了两万单。
A niche, high-bar track — and you've sold 20,000 units.
a niche high-bar track（小众高门槛的赛道）
给它一个卖点：因为好看，因为它帅。
Give it a selling point: it's good-looking, it's cool.
a selling point（卖点）
paraphrase: 小众高门槛 → niche, high-bar / a niche with high barriers
圈人群 → target the audience / win over a crowd
scenes.speak: This mask gets no traffic at scenic spots, but it sells out in your stream. A niche, high-bar track — and you've sold 20,000 units. Give it a selling point: it's good-looking, it's cool.

scenes.context: 圈人群话术：直播间有没有喜欢玩葫芦的？喜欢玩城隍道件的？玩到顶了、玩腻了？想不想玩点不一样的、别人没玩的？人来了你就圈人群。语域：直播教学，话术示范。
sentences: 直播间有没有喜欢玩葫芦的、玩到顶了的？
Anyone in the chat into gourds, who's played them all?
into gourds（喜欢玩葫芦的）
想不想玩一点别人没玩的？
Want to try something no one else has played?
no one else has played（别人没玩的）
人来了，你就圈人群。
Once people are in, you lock onto your crowd.
lock onto your crowd（圈人群）
paraphrase: 玩到顶 → played them all / hit the ceiling
played them all · hit the ceiling
圈人群 → lock onto the crowd / capture the segment
scenes.speak: Anyone in the chat into gourds, who's played them all? Want to try something no one else has played? Once people are in, you lock onto your crowd.

scenes.context: 圈宝妈人群：宝宝老哭老闹？你买平安扣、平安钵、节节高。买完发现还是那个样，人人都在戴。你不能说它没用，但见到它之后你会发现平安钵包括那些佩饰全是这个。语域：直播教学，人群切入。
sentences: 宝宝老哭老闹？你就去买平安扣。
Baby keeps crying and fussing? Go buy a safety pendant.
safety pendant（平安扣）
买完发现还是那个样，人人都在戴。
After buying, it's still the same — everyone wears one.
everyone wears one（人人都在戴）
见到它之后，你发现平安钵全是这个。
Once you see it, you find the blessing bowl is just like this.
blessing bowl（平安钵）
paraphrase: 老哭老闹 → crying and fussing / fussy and tearful
平安扣 → safety pendant / peace pendant
scenes.speak: Baby keeps crying and fussing? Go buy a safety pendant. After buying, it's still the same — everyone wears one. Once you see it, you find the blessing bowl is just like this.

scenes.title_en: Wrap-Up: Learn Something, Don't Get Scammed
scenes.context: 你可以不买，在直播间学点东西也挺好。以后见到这类东西你正好知道是什么，不会被骗。我们家这些全是手工的。语域：直播教学，信任收尾。
sentences: 你可以不买，学点东西也挺好。
You don't have to buy — learning something is just as good.
learning something（学点东西）
以后你正好知道这东西是什么，不会被骗。
Next time you'll know exactly what it is and won't get scammed.
won't get scammed（不会被骗）
我们家这些，全是手工的。
Everything in our shop is handmade.
handmade（手工的）
paraphrase: 不被骗 → won't get scammed / avoid being fooled
手工的 → handmade / crafted by hand
scenes.speak: You don't have to buy — learning something is just as good. Next time you'll know exactly what it is and won't get scammed. Everything in our shop is handmade.

practice: A niche, high-bar track — and you've sold 20,000 units.
Once people are in, you lock onto your crowd.
Baby keeps crying and fussing? Go buy a safety pendant.
Next time you'll know exactly what it is and won't get scammed.
pitfalls: This mask gets no traffic at scenic spots.
「圈人群」用 lock onto the crowd，不是 circle people。
「老哭老闹」用 keeps crying and fussing。
shifts: 用 a selling point（卖点）、no traffic（没流量）、sold 20,000 units（卖两万单）
用 lock onto your crowd（圈人群）、target the audience（锁定受众）、into gourds（喜欢玩葫芦的）
用 handmade（手工的）、blessing bowl（平安钵）、safety pendant（平安扣）
